scope: New requests refresh source while retaining the original task baseline
First manual annotation request initializes structural reading
Changed semantic briefs still require annotation
Product Fresh Eyes retains actual durable child IDs across unrelated edits and later inspection
Old model results remain rejected after a new capture

request_cost.scope: Unchanged single-module annotation request creation on isolated knowledge copies of identical actual source, including request persistence

limits: Shared-machine serial timings measure request-capture overhead, not mapping throughput or model latency. Synthetic responses are used only in regression fixtures. This establishes source identity, workflow qualification and child lineage behavior; it does not establish improved architectural recommendation quality.
